review.resolution: Adjudicated in favor of annotation B on both disagreements: (1) fundamentacao_legal — A tagged only 'nos termos do art. 924, inciso II, do Novo Código de Processo Civil'; B additionally tagged 'conforme provimento n. 016/2010-CG', a second, distinct legal-authority citation later in the same document. Guideline Rule for fundamentacao_legal explicitly requires tagging every distinct citation, not just the first — B's 2 spans are adopted. (2) dispositivo_abertura — A tagged none (the category was in its covered_categories but it found no anchor); B tagged 'Considerando a satisfação da obrigação', the formulaic phrase immediately preceding the operative verb JULGO EXTINTO, functionally equivalent to the guideline's own examples ('Ante o exposto'/'Pelo exposto'/'Posto isso') and within the guideline's 1-5 word anchor-length norm — adopted as a real anchor A missed, not an over-tag by B. All other spans (cabecalho_inicio/fim, ref_processual, resultado, encerramento_inicio/fim) were identical between A and B and required no adjudication.
